dct_description_sm: Panama administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 13 province or indigenous territory (provincia o comarca comarca indígena) - Admin 2: 76 district or indigenous territory (distrito o comarca indígena) - Admin 3: 594 municpiality (corregimiento) Dates associated with this dataset: - 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 20 October 2021: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 15 June 2020: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 15 June 2020: boundaries created by the source Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
